data.content_ref: inline:The abstraction claim fails to supply a causal mechanism. The target says linear additive weighting is 'a specific instance of a misinterpretation failure where the non-expert cannot synthesize the interaction of variables,' but this does not establish why the linear weighting structurally produces misinterpretation rather than merely being associated with it. An abstraction relation must name the shared causal property that makes the specific instance inherit the general failure mode; here the target only re-describes the symptom (non-synthesis of variables) without specifying the mechanism connecting additive weighting to misinterpretation as such. The result is a relabeling, not an abstraction with a mechanism.
